scalars.scalar_value: One (1) or more years community college teaching experience

items.item_text: 01. Which option below best describes your highest level of education? (NOTE: For positions requiring college units/degree, a copy of the transcript must be included as an attachment. The transcript must be legible from an accredited institution and include your name, the institution name and confer date). Options: Some High School | High School or G.E.D. | Some College | Associates Degree | Bachelors Degree | Masters Degree | Doctorate Degree | None
02. Did you attach the required transcripts? Options: Yes | No
03. Select the career website you used to find this employment opportunity: Options: Sbccd.edu | Indeed.com | HigherEdJobs.com | EdJoin.org | CCCregistry.org | Other
04. Describe your experience teaching at a community college. Please include length of time.

05. Describe your experience demonstrating knowledge of general and organic chemistry and the ability to effectively communicate these concepts to community college STEM students. Please include length of time.
06. Explain your experience collaborating with colleagues and contributing to programs that support teaching, learning, and service for a diverse student population. Include length of time.

07. Describe your experience using multiple teaching methods to support students with diverse learning styles, as evidenced by course syllabi, lesson plans, or student feedback. Please use include length of time.

08. Explain your experience designing and delivering effective instruction in on-campus, hybrid, and AI-enhanced learning environments, using appropriate technologies and instructional practices to support student success. Include length of time.

09. I hereby understand and declare that the statements on this supplemental questionnaire are true and complete to the best of my knowledge. As applicable, I hereby authorize the District and/or designees to contact the references listed to verify the information I have supplied. I hereby release from liability all persons and organizations furnishing such information. I understand that the District reserves the right to validate information received on the supplemental questionnaire and that I will be subject to disqualification and/or termination if any statement in this supplemental questionnaire is found to be untrue or determined to be misleading. Options: Yes | No
One (1) or more years community college teaching experience
One (1) or more years demonstrated experience collaborating with colleagues and contributing to programs that support teaching, learning, and service for a diverse student population.
One (1) or more years demonstrated experience using multiple teaching methods to support students with diverse learning styles, as evidenced by course syllabi, lesson plans, or student feedback.

One (1) or more years demonstrated experience designing and delivering effective instruction in on-campus, hybrid, and AI-enhanced learning environments, using appropriate technologies and instructional practices to support student success.
One (1) or more years of demonstrated knowledge of general and organic chemistry and the ability to effectively communicate these concepts to community college STEM students.
